text:
Maya R.: heads up — i'm going to start splitting the large "docs/gallery" refactor into 4 PRs to avoid a giant preview timeout. planning PRs: move-guides, rename-components, redirects, anchor-fixes.

Josh L.: ok, timeline? CI previews are flaky if we queue >2 at once.

Maya R.: aim to open them in a staggered way over the morning. PR1 (move-guides) will be ready in ~30m. i'll @Anita for reviewers on the rename PR.

Anita: thanks — i can take review windows at 10a and 2p PT. please mark the rename PR as "review-needed" and tag me.

Maya R.: will do. one ask: anchor-fixes PR touches a lot of old anchors that redirect rules rely on — we need a short smoke checklist before merge.

Luca: +1 on checklist. also add a step to re-run the redirect test harness: `make test-redirects` (it checks for 301 loops and broken anchors).

docs-preview-bot: Preview for PR #4218 (move-guides) ready: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4218 — note: build time 3m45s.

Josh L.: i looked at #4218 — small nit: the migration guide links under "deployments" now point to /deploy vs /deployments (intentional?).

Maya R.: yep intentional for consolidation, but i will add redirects for the old paths in PR3 (redirects). not changing the content links in #4218 to avoid churn.

Anita: good call. for rename-components PR (4220) — can we avoid changing anchor ids for the public SDK examples? those anchors are referenced by external blog posts.

Maya R.: thanks — i'll keep SDK example anchors stable and add explicit redirect anchors where headers change. the anchor-fixes PR will only adjust internal-only headings.

Evan: small concern: if we merge move-guides first, previews for the later PRs may fail since files are moved. recommend merging in this order: move-guides -> redirects -> rename-components -> anchor-fixes.

Luca: agree. redirects should go before renames so the site serves old paths while the rename merge updates canonical locations.

Maya R.: action list: (1) open PRs now (2) stagger merges per Evan order (3) run `make test-redirects` after redirects merge (4) Anita to sign off on rename during 10a slot.

Josh L.: i'll queue a quick CI priority for the redirects PR — ping me when it's green and i'll escalate to the preview infra team if it flakes.

Maya R.: tagged the PRs: #4218, #4220, #4223, #4229. will post links as they go live. thanks everyone :) :thumbsup:

docs-preview-bot: Heads-up — netlify preview concurrency is limited to 3 for the org. Try to keep parallel builds <=3 to avoid queueing.
